useWhen: independent QA scenarios can run in parallel
visual or browser evidence review can be split by page, role, or flow
log, report, and artifact triage can be split by artifact
security, performance, accessibility, or regression review is bounded and evidence-only
each subagent receives one concrete QA card with expected output
doNotUseWhen: task needs one shared live browser session with mutable state
human login, MFA, payment, account consent, or credential action is required
operation is destructive outside the local trust boundary
work cannot be split into independent evidence-producing cards
running more agents would duplicate the same task or hide evidence
stopConditions: available Spark quota is exhausted or unavailable
no useful independent testing work remains
site, account, or browser state is unstable and parallelism would corrupt evidence
critical production-impacting blocker requires primary-agent review
